meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 把整套餐改成语义：每个智能体小组一个独立 Slack 应用，保留身份、工作区、记忆和原有接线；不创建小组，不修改工作区；也可选择留在经典模式并记录决定。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示需要 Slack agents 迁移时，或你随时主动要求迁移时。

howto.what_en: Converts classic single-bot Slack setups into one named app per agent group, preserving identities, workspaces, memory and wiring; or records the decision to remain classic. It never creates agent groups or edits workspaces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or anytime the operator invokes the skill standalone.

say_en.text: Migrate our classic single-bot Slack to one app per agent group.
say_en.note: Inventories and proposes the mapping before changing anything.

say_en.text: Record that we're staying on classic Slack.
say_en.note: Acknowledges the decision without changing the setup.

say_en.text: Check whether we still have the classic Slack state.
say_en.note: Runs detection and reports if there's nothing to migrate.
